doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Wayne's path into the business and booking together
summary: Wayne went from disco to working with him at the North Park, Rush Street and the Blackstone, and now they book together.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I had an interesting conversation with Wayne. You know, I guess his early pursuit professionally was not where he ended up now, but...
No, he was into disco and all that stuff, and I got him working with me when he was about twenty - I guess he started. And he worked with me at the North Park and he
worked on Rush Street, downstairs, and subsequently at the Blackstone he started to take more active, you know.
And Wayne does, besides the finances, he also books all the bands coming in? Or are you involved in that process?

And we get our heads together and we get our heads together and see what’s what, and see who were losses last time and we don’t book them again, or whatever, you know. He takes care of the hotels and all that.
